Use your own stock list

Drop Excel or CSV here, or choose a file.

Common ERP headers work as they are. Include stock on hand and at least 3 full months of sales. Excel up to 20 MiB; standard CSV up to 2 MiB.

Using built-in sample data · synthetic, not real stock.

All settings

Inventory terms, in plain words
Lead time
Days from order to delivery.
MOQ
Smallest order the supplier accepts.
Safety stock
Extra kept for delays or surprise demand.
Reorder point
Order when stock drops to this amount.

The standalone page uses the same forecast and order calculations as the Desktop plugin. Purchase quantities deduct stock and incoming, and use snapshot-anchored calendar demand. It does not contact an ERP or send orders.

Free and open source · Stock Runway · runs entirely in your browser, your file never leaves this device
